Hi everyone!

I just joined last month and have been quietly studying and observing. I feel I got enough understanding to finally start a journal and begin posting some analysis.

There are so many ways to trade within RTM cookbook so I'll focus on the one which make sense to me first, that's this quote below from IF: "Certainly there's an awful lot to learn here. But if I were to summarise what I think is most important, I'd say look to an engulf into free space that hasn't yet hit the origin (tg). Very often it will retrace deeply before advancing to the origin. Learn to spot these, and you'll be better equipped than most other traders out there."

Here are some screenshots on this setup.

Thanks AK for highlighting the FIRST LAW OF ENGULF.

So here's my step by step plan to trade this setup in my own words:

1. DIRECTION: Look for PAZ (space between two FTR). The FTR which didn't get hit after the ENGULF will be our TG 2. ENTRY: Pullback to MPL within opposing FL 3. SL: At the extreme edge of the opposing FL 4. TP: As per #1 above.

Pls advice whether I get this concept right. Thank you in advance for helping me in this wonderful journal. I'm grateful to all of you!

JC
